name: Ravioli with Cheesy Butternut Squash Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small butternut squash
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the squash has about 10 minutes left, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and ravioli, then stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and set aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
2 (10 oz) pkg cheese ravioli, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the squash is done, transfer to a blender. Add broth, milk, salt, and pepper, then blend on high until sauce is smooth, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup whole milk
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer sauce to the reserved pot and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, add cheese and cook, stirring constantly, until melted and combined. Add drained ravioli, stir to combine, and continue to cook until warmed through, 1 minute more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide ravioli between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
